experiment: 603986 single-stock weekly model, first retrospective walk-forward test
window: Five calendar years of mature anchors; require 125 consecutive observed exchange sessions and all joint target sessions; exclude any missing stock session, no fill. Earliest fold has at least 800 retained daily anchors. Availability determines start, not prediction outcomes.
target: Gross open-to-open stock holding-period return including split shares and nominal cash dividends, before costs/taxes. Entry is next exchange-session open; exit is the session after the next observed same weekday on the exchange calendar. Friday signals only in evaluation. Holidays can extend the nominal week. Cash entitlement on entry ex-date excluded, on exit ex-date included. Auxiliary target: next five exchange-session forward-adjusted OHLCV. All components mature by annual cutoff.
adjustment: Construct forward wealth OHLC from unadjusted OHLC, cumulative split shares and cash on/before each bar. Volume divided by cumulative split shares. Cross-check vendor hfq to 0.005 currency units allowing accumulated vendor intermediate rounding across nine actions. Do not use current qfq to train. Vendor raw vintage remains retrospective, not proven point-in-time.
neural: Original combined Crossformer, 38551 parameters, independent fresh random initialization for each stock cutoff/seed. Seeds 20260910,20260911,20260912. 20 natural epochs, batch128, AdamW lr0.001 weight_decay0.1 dropout0.3, clip1. Standardized gross-return MSE +0.1 standardized OHLCV auxiliary MSE. Deterministic CUDA float32, TF32 off. No index checkpoint or index training rows.
features: Same 25 neural features and four stock-local descriptors: trend60, volatility20, range20, volume_change20. Train-only clipping/scaling; same volatility interaction and close-price rise/fall sign-order interaction. Order does not mean order-book. No financial statements, news, sector, external market indicators or analyst estimates as features in v1.
heads: Original fixed lambda0.01 convex logistic heads, R26 solvers. U uniform; W time-decay half-life730.5days, reusing U coordinates; I and S swap only weighted intercept or weighted slopes respectively. Three-seed probability mean, strict p>0.5. All 20 combinations reported, no best-model deployment.
quarter: Stock-only annual out-of-sample U bank. No CSI300 calibration rows. R39 state-gated policy: trend60<0 vs >=0; volatility20>annual training median high. 52 mature weekly train rows, purged 13 mature validation rows; train state>=10, validation state>=5; ridge sum20, cap0.5 logit, 60 bisections; accept only ensemble Brier improvement>1e-12 and no direction loss. Reset to zero in Q1; insufficient evidence exact zero. No quarter-specific full-network refit.
controls: Annual mature daily training-up frequency, always-up, train-only four-market-descriptor logistic lambda0.01, native neural MSE direction and annual training mean-return direction. Native/mean returns have no fabricated probabilities.
evaluation: Common mature Friday anchors; three seeds are not independent weeks. Report pooled and annual direction accuracy and Brier/logloss for genuine probabilistic outputs, native return MAE/RMSE. Fixed main U learned_vol_interaction vs training frequency on paired Brier with 8-week circular moving-block bootstrap10000 seed20260915 and descriptive 95% percentile difference interval. Also compare main vs market4; Holm-adjust their two centered two-sided bootstrap p-values. All 20 arms descriptive, no winner selection or tuning. No claim of untouched holdout: historical data and stock chosen after prior market inspection.
latest: Any last-Friday output calculated now is a retrospective reconstruction, never a forecast issued before that Friday. Do not insert it into the index prospective journal. No trading execution, fill assumption, PnL backtest or deployment.
horizon: First version tests one weekly target; it is not a separately validated four-week model.
freeze: Freeze protocol, source and data before all neural fits and scoring. Contract and independent post-fit checks required. Preserve failed attempts; never change the protocol based on stock test performance. Preserve all existing index artifacts and journals.
